storylines.label: Fable Mythos
storylines.latest_title: [AINews] Fable and Mythos officially too dangerous to release

editorial.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and the higher Mythos 5 tier on Jun 9. Early hands-on reports described a powerful but slow and expensive model with unusually proactive behavior, while launch coverage raised concerns about its usage terms. After Anthropic published access details, the story turned sharply on Jun 13: a US government export-control directive suspended access, followed by industry coverage framing the models as too sensitive to release.

storylines.label: Dynamic Workflows
storylines.latest_title: A Harness For Every Task Dynamic Workflows In Claude Code

editorial.tldr: Anthropic introduced Dynamic Workflows (“ultracode”) for Claude Code, first surfaced in late May alongside the Opus 4.8 release and detailed over the following days. The capability coordinates large numbers of agents within a single workflow to take on complex engineering tasks, with Anthropic's own “A Harness For Every Task” post laying out the model.
